text:
The statute will most likely be declared unconstitutional: the 7% signature requirement, combined with the short 180-day circulation period, imposes a severe burden on independent candidates' and political bodies' ballot access, infringing First and Fourteenth Amendment rights of association and voting under Anderson v. Celebrezze. Because established parties get an easier route to the ballot, the law discriminates against independents and cannot survive strict scrutiny.  
CONFIDENCE: 85
